01-02: Returns from ten years abroad and makes his first appearance in Petersburg society at @anna_pav's soirée [1, 2].
01-03: Observes the Abbé Morio and waits for an opportunity to express his own intellectual views [2].
01-05: Desperately defends the French Revolution and Napoleon's 'greatness of soul' in executing the Duc d’Enghien, horrifying the guests [3-7].
01-07: Confesses he has not yet chosen a career despite being in Petersburg for three months [8].
01-09: Breaks a promise to @andrew and joins @anatole_kuragin for a night of drinking; helps @dolokhov secure a window-ledge bet [9-11].
01-10: Becomes the subject of Moscow gossip following a prank involving a bear and a policeman [12].
01-16: Visits his dying father; meets @boris and impulsively decides they must be friends [13-15].
01-18: Attends the @rostov_family dinner but remains socially awkward; is publicly reprimanded by @marya_dm for the bear incident [16, 17].
01-20: Dances with @natasha, appearing to her as a 'funny' but impressive grown-up [18, 19].
01-22: Is led by @anna_mikh through the back stairs to see his dying father [20-22].
01-23: Performs the 'awful rite' of saying goodbye to his father, kissing the dying man’s hand [23, 24].
01-24: Inherits his father's massive fortune and title after @anna_mikh secures the will [25, 26].
03-01: Becomes the most sought-after bachelor in Petersburg society due to his inheritance.
03-02: Is socially maneuvered by @vasily into a reluctant engagement with @helene.
04-04: Dueling with @dolokhov after receiving an anonymous letter about @helene's infidelity.
05-01: Meets the Freemason Bazdéev at a station and decides to join the Brotherhood for spiritual renewal.
06-07: Becomes disillusioned with the Petersburg Freemasons and their superficiality.

01-04: Appears at the soirée appearing bored by society; reveals he is going to war as an aide-de-camp to Kutúzov [27, 28].
01-05: Defends Napoleon as a great man, though admits some of his actions are hard to justify [29-31].
01-07: Advises @pierre never to marry until he is 'old and good for nothing'; expresses deep frustration with his own marriage to @lise [32, 33].
01-26: Arrives at Bald Hills with his pregnant wife, @lise; discusses military strategy with his father, @nikolai_bolkonski [34, 35].
01-28: Leaves for the war; receives an antique icon from his sister @mary; tells his father he would be 'ashamed' to be a coward [36-38].
02-03: Serves as Kutúzov's trusted adjutant; rebukes Zherkóv for making jokes after the disastrous news of Mack’s surrender [39-41].
02-09: Reports the victory at Krems to the Austrian court; enjoys the feeling of 'long-desired happiness' [42, 43].
02-12: Is discouraged by the coldness of the Austrian Minister of War; learns that Vienna has fallen [44-52].
02-13: Rushes back to the army; intervenes to help a doctor's wife during the chaotic retreat [53-57].
02-21: Attends Bagratión's council; bravely defends @tushin against accusations of losing guns [58, 59].

01-11: Introduced as a thirteen-year-old 'volcano' of life; bursts into the drawing room with her doll [88-91].
01-13: Witnesses @nicholas and @sonya kissing; subsequently maneuvers @boris into a kiss and a marriage pact [62, 63, 92-95].
01-19: Boldly challenges @marya_dm at dinner by asking what dessert will be served [96-98].
01-20: Consoles @sonya over @nicholas’s impending departure; dances with the 'funny' @pierre [18, 19, 64].

01-11: Introduced as an impulsive undergraduate who has decided to join the hussars [60, 61].
01-13: Confesses his love to his cousin @sonya and kisses her in the conservatory [62, 63].
01-20: Sings 'The Brook' at his family's party; comforts a jealous @sonya [64, 65].
02-04: Serves as a cadet in the Pávlograd Hussars; realizes his money has been stolen by Telyánin [66-68].
02-05: Confronts Telyánin; returns the money but is shamed; refuses to apologize to his colonel [69-76].
02-08: Experiences his first time under fire at the Enns bridge; feels excitement and terror [77-80].
02-19: During a charge, his horse is killed and he is wounded; flees the French in a panic [81-83].
02-21: Retreats on a gun carriage, feeling lonely and questioning the war [59, 84-87].

01-01: Hosts a high-society soirée in Petersburg; complains about Napoleon (the 'Antichrist') and political unrest.
01-02: Skillfully manages her guests like a weaver, ensuring the social flow is perfect; introduces @pierre to society.
01-04: Discusses a potential marriage match between @anatole_kuragin and the wealthy @mary.

01-01: Attends @anna_pav's soirée; schemes to get his 'profligate' son @anatole_kuragin married to @mary.
01-21: Plots with the eldest princess to intercept Count Bezúkhov's will, fearing @pierre will inherit everything [63, 64].
01-24: Unsuccessfully tries to seize the portfolio containing the will during a physical struggle with @anna_mikh [65, 66].
03-01: Takes control of @pierre's affairs after he inherits, installing him in his own house to manage his wealth [67, 68].
03-02: Maneuvers @pierre into an engagement with his daughter @helene through social pressure [69, 70].
03-03: Visits @nikolai_bolkonski at Bald Hills to propose the match between @anatole_kuragin and @marya [71, 72].
04-06: Following the duel between @pierre and @dolokhov, he attempts to convince @pierre of @helene's innocence, but is kicked out [73, 74].

01-04: Appears at the soirée to beg @vasily to use his influence for her son, @boris [99-101].
01-14: Confesses her extreme poverty to the @countess_rostova; plans to visit Count Bezúkhov for money [102, 103].
01-24: Physically struggles with @catiche for the portfolio containing the count's will; secures @pierre’s inheritance [109-113].

01-02: Present at @anna_pav's soirée; described as a stunning, statuesque beauty who is the 'pearl' of Petersburg society.
01-03: Enchants the guests with her smile; @pierre is struck by her beauty.

01-13: Engages in a flirtatious marriage pact with @natasha in the conservatory [92-95].
01-16: Meets @pierre at the dying Count Bezúkhov's house; maintains a dignified, proud demeanor despite his poverty.

01-13: The 'sterile flower'; kisses @nicholas and vows her eternal devotion to him [62, 63].
01-20: Weeps over @nicholas's departure for the army; comforted by @natasha [64, 65].

01-09: Introduced as a notorious gambler; wins a bet by drinking rum on a window ledge [114-116].
02-20: Leads a successful ambush; kills a Frenchman and captures an officer [120-123].

02-15: Found by @andrew in a sutler's tent without his boots; appears timid [124-126].
02-17: Commands a battery that sets fire to Schön Grabern; operates in a 'feverish delirium' [127-129].
02-21: Is defended by @andrew after being blamed for losing guns [58, 130-132].

01-14: Identified as a wealthy, stingy, and eccentric retired general nicknamed 'the King of Prussia' [1].
01-25: Maintains a strict routine at Bald Hills, valuing activity and intelligence while despising idleness and superstition [2].
Personally educates @mary in algebra and geometry to develop her mind [2, 3].
01-26: Receives @andrew and @lise at Bald Hills, remaining skeptical of the multi-national military strategy against Napoleon [2, 4].
01-28: Gives @andrew a final warning that he would be 'ashamed' if his son behaved unworthily in the war [5, 6].
Angrily dismisses @andrew when the moment of parting becomes too emotional [7].
03-03: Receives a letter from @vasily and expresses contempt for his character, though he agrees to the visit regarding @mary [8, 9].
Publicly humiliates @mary for her appearance when she dresses up for the visitors [10, 11].
03-04: Subjects @anatole_kuragin to a rigorous and mocking interrogation about his military service and education [12, 13].
03-05: Jokingly tells @mary that @anatole_kuragin would likely take @bourienne as his wife and her only as a dowry [14].
Is pleased when @mary chooses to stay with him rather than marry @anatole_kuragin [15].
05-08: Appointed as one of the eight commanders in chief for the national enrollment, which grants him a new surge of energy [16].
05-14: Hotly disputes the possibility of perpetual peace with @pierre, calling such ideas 'old women’s nonsense' [17, 18].

01-25: Lives under her father’s strict tutelage at Bald Hills, finding solace in correspondence with Julie Karágina [2, 19].
01-28: Gives @andrew an antique icon to wear at war, expressing her deep religious devotion [20, 21].
Promises to look after the pregnant @lise during @andrew's absence [22, 23].
03-03: Struggles with her own self-image and spiritual doubts upon hearing of @anatole_kuragin's impending visit [24, 25].
03-04: Is struck by @anatole_kuragin's physical beauty but remains socially awkward in his presence [26, 27].
03-05: Formally refuses @anatole_kuragin’s proposal, deciding her vocation lies in self-sacrifice and religious devotion [30, 31].
05-08: Becomes the primary caretaker for her nephew, little Prince Nicholas, following @lise's death [16].
05-13: Secretly hosts 'God’s folk' (pilgrims) at Bald Hills against her father's explicit orders [32, 33].

01-04: Andrew Bolkónski is appointed as his aide-de-camp as he prepares for the 1805 campaign [34, 35].
02-01: Inspects a Russian regiment at Braunau, intentionally showing the Austrian generals the troops' exhausted state and poor boots [36, 37].
02-02: Recognizes and greets Timókhin, an officer he remembers from the siege of Ismail [38, 39].
02-03: Receives news of General Mack’s surrender and realizes the allied campaign is in jeopardy [40].
02-14: Tactically maneuvers a three-day truce with Murat to allow his army and transport to escape destruction [41, 42].
03-11: Correctly predicts that the Battle of Austerlitz will be lost but is ignored by the Tsar's inner circle [43].
03-12: Falls asleep during the council of war while Weyrother reads the complex battle dispositions [44].
03-16: Is wounded in the cheek during the chaotic retreat at Austerlitz [45].
Despairingly asks @andrew what is happening to the disordered battalions [46].
04-02: Subject of harsh gossip in Moscow, where he is blamed for the defeat while Bagratión is hailed as a hero [47, 48].

01-25: Serves as @marya's companion at Bald Hills, bringing an air of French gaiety to the somber household [49].
03-03: Enthusiastically helps @lise dress @marya for @anatole_kuragin's arrival while secretly admiring him herself [50, 51].
03-04: Flirts openly with @anatole_kuragin and dreams of him being the 'Russian prince' who will carry her away [27, 52].
03-05: Is caught in an embrace with @anatole_kuragin by @marya in the conservatory [28].
Weeps and begs @marya's forgiveness, which is granted with saintly compassion [29, 53].

01-01: Described by @anna_pav and his father as an 'active fool' whose profligate lifestyle costs 40,000 rubles a year [54, 55].
01-09: Hosts a night of drinking and debauchery in Petersburg, encouraging @pierre to break his word to @andrew [56, 57].
01-10: Subject of Moscow gossip regarding an incident where a policeman was tied to a bear [58].
03-03: Arrives at Bald Hills to court @marya; he is indifferent to her but considers the marriage for her fortune [59, 60].
03-04: Ignores @marya to flirt with @bourienne, finding the companion far more attractive [27, 61].
03-05: Caught embracing @bourienne by @marya; he treats the incident with a gay, shameless smile [28, 29].

01-01: Described by his father as a 'quiet fool' [54].
01-02: Appears at @anna_pav's soirée with Mortemart; he is described as an 'exceedingly ugly' version of his sister [75, 76].
01-05: Attempts to smooth over @pierre's awkward political outburst by telling a 'charming Moscow story' in broken Russian [77, 78].
01-06: Awkwardly lingers by the pregnant @lise as she leaves the soirée, staring at her through an eyeglass [79-81].
03-11: Works as a secretary to the embassy in Brünn, where he is the constant butt of jokes among the diplomatic circle [82, 83].
05-07: Tells an unpopular joke at @anna_pav's soirée, suggesting it is wrong to fight 'pour le Roi de Prusse' (for the King of Prussia) [84, 85].

01-18: Arrives at the Rostóvs' name-day dinner, commanding immediate respect from all guests [1, 2].
Publicly reprimands @pierre for the 'bear incident' in Petersburg, telling him he should be at the war instead of making a fool of himself [3].
Corrects the hussar colonel for his loud behavior at the table, noting she has four sons in the army but does not 'fret' like him [4, 5].
01-19: Presents @natasha, whom she affectionately calls 'her Cossack,' with a pair of ruby earrings [6].

Is the target of @natasha’s 'incredible boldness' when the girl interrupts dinner to demand what is for dessert; she responds with a joke about 'carrot ices' before laughing at the girl's spirit [7, 8].
01-20: Dances the 'Daniel Cooper' with @count_ilyá_rostov; despite her massive stature and habitual severity, her agility and 'beaming face' during the dance enchant the onlookers [9-11].
03-03: Remains a staple of the English Club gossip; she is used as a standard for the 'old-school' Moscow integrity that contrasts with the newer, more cynical generation [12, 13].
